# ThemeMode

`Flare.Abstractions.Tokens.ThemeMode`

Light/dark selection for a theme. A theme carries both schemes (via its palette); the mode chooses which one is active. Auto follows the OS preference. HighContrast uses a high-contrast color scheme for accessibility.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Light` | `0` | Always use the light color scheme. |
| `Dark` | `1` | Always use the dark color scheme. |
| `Auto` | `2` | Follow the OS prefers-color-scheme setting. |
| `HighContrast` | `3` | Use high-contrast color scheme for improved accessibility (WCAG AAA). |

## Used by components

- `FlareThemeScope`
